<!-- Thanks for contributing code! Please include a description of your change and check your pull request against the list below. For further questions, refer to the contributing guide (https://github.com/Cantera/cantera/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

**Changes proposed in this pull request**

Claude and I went through the backlog of bugs identified by the thermodynamic consistency tests.

<!-- Provide a clear and concise description of changes and/or features introduced in this pull request. -->

- Implement `cv_mole` for `PDSS_HKFT` class. This standard-state model has a volume that depends on pressure, so $c_v \ne c_p $.
- Fix calculation of $c_p$ in `PDSS_SSVol`, where there was a term not being scaled by $R$.
- Implement proper `cv_mole` for `IdealSolnGasVPSS` and `MargulesVPSSTP`. For purely incompressible standard-state models, $c_v = c_p$ (but definitely not $c_v = c_p - R$, as these classes used). However, for phases containing the full water EoS or HKFT species, the implementation is more complex.
- Fix handling of "excess volume" terms in `MargulesVPSSTP` and add a test that exercises this capability
- Fix density calculations in `GibbsExcessVPSSTP`, which neglected pressure-dependent terms for the standard states.
- Fix conversion of molality-based activity coefficients to the mole-fraction basis used at the `ThermoPhase` level
- Fix finite difference calculation of $A_{\rm Debye}$ in the `WaterProps` class, which was incorrectly dividing by $T + \Delta T$ instead of just $\Delta T$. Also switch to a centered difference for better accuracy.
- Fix the calculation of the activity coefficient pressure derivative in the `DebyeHuckel` class
- Fix the calculation of $c_p$ in the dilute limit with variable $A_{\rm Debye}$ in the `DebyeHuckel` class
- Fix the partial molar entropy calculation in `IdealMolalSoln`, which was missing a factor of $R$ on the standard state term.
- Fix consistency of `BinarySolutionTabulatedThermo` values near the composition limits, and clarify some of the remaining unusual behavior.
- Simplify direct execution of test binaries without needing extra environment variables by setting `RPATH` to include the build location of `libcantera` and setting data directory paths relative to the repository root.

**If applicable, fill in the issue number this pull request is fixing**

Finite difference calculation for the temperature derivative of the
thermal expansion coefficient should divide by delta-T, not T plus delta-T.
Also switch to a centered difference to improve accuracy.

Fixes #1324.

commits.messageHeadline: [Thermo] Fix Debye-Huckel activity coefficient pressure derivative

commits.messageBody:
…ebye

The solvent (k=0) activity coefficient in the dilute-limit Debye-Huckel
model contains composition-dependent terms that are not proportional to
A_Debye. The d2lnActCoeff/dT2 calculation was incorrectly applying the
formula for solutes (lnActCoeff * d2A/dT2 / A) to the solvent as well,
which introduced a spurious Cp contribution.

Mirrors the analogous fix applied to dlnActCoeff/dP in the previous
commit. Closes GitHub Issue #1500.

commits.messageBody:
getPartialMolarEntropies() was calling getEntropy_R() (which returns
dimensionless s/R values) and then subtracting activity-based
corrections in J/kmol/K without first converting to physical units.
The fix adds the missing multiplication by GasConstant, matching the
pattern used by DebyeHuckel and IdealSolnGasVPSS.

Removes known-failure entries for g_eq_h_minus_Ts, gk_eq_hk_minus_T_sk,
and cp_eq_dsdT_const_p_times_T from the IdealMolalSolution consistency
test suite, and updates the IMSTester regression values accordingly.

Fixes GitHub Issue #1300.
